messages:
emma (devex): Support ticket TKT-1213: customer can't use RedwoodAsyncClient behind corp proxy on Windows + Dedicated. Sync OK. Error: 
```
ssl.SSLCertVerificationError: certificate verify failed: unable to get local issuer certificate
```

sam (py-sdk): Likely we're not wiring an SSLContext into aiohttp TCPConnector. Requests honors REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE but aiohttp needs explicit ssl param.

kai (infra): Quick repro on Win11. Async client constructs ClientSession(connector=TCPConnector()) with no ssl. Workaround is to pass a prebuilt session using ssl.SSLContext.load_verify_locations().

doc (support): customer asked for simple param not a custom session. Can client API add cafile/trust_bundle + env var support?

sam (py-sdk): Agreed. Plan: add trust_bundle: Optional[str] and ssl_context: Optional[ssl.SSLContext] to RedwoodAsyncClient, env var REDWOOD_TRUST_BUNDLE precedence, create context with create_default_context(cafile=...) and pass to TCPConnector(ssl=ctx). Add docs and Windows note.

ci-bot: Created issue redwood/redwood-py#529: "async client: support trust_bundle/ssl_context + windows cert handling" by kai.

emma (devex): Thanks — linking to TKT-1213 so onboarding team can update customer when patch lands. :thumbsup:
